slides.headline: SC: No Birthright for Grandson in Father's Partition Share
slides.photo_credit: Photo: Subhashish Panigrahi / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

bullets: Father's share of a partitioned estate is his own
Not joint family or coparcenary property, the court said
Grandson can't sue for it while his father lives

slides.stat_label: Who Inherits Under Section 8, Per the Court
bullets: Applies when the grandfather died without a will
A son's son is not a Class I heir
The son of a predeceased son is one

slides.stat_label: From a 1997 Suit to the Supreme Court
bullets: Father got the plot in a 1994 partition decree
Father sold it in 1997; grandson sued that year
Supreme Court dismissed the grandson's appeal on 6 November
